profile_text.body:
Berkshire Grey is a for-profit company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts. Its website describes it as a provider of AI-powered robotic automation solutions for warehouse, ecommerce, retail, and 3PL logistics operations, which the company says accelerate fulfillment, reduce operating costs, and scale with a customer's business.

The site names one product, Stride, described as a shuttle sorting system that handles a wide range of item types using autonomous shuttles and intelligent routing to automate sorting with reliable, scalable throughput.
